title: The New AI Development Cycle for Power Platform
summary: Building with AI is all about context. Seven practices across discovery, planning, backlog, development, testing, deployment, and best practices, measured with an 'efficiency number'.
whyItMatters: Gives a delivery model and a metric for running AI-assisted projects.

keyPoints.heading: Context first
keyPoints.text: You're building a solution, not a tool. Train a 'second brain' with business, technical, and people context; be selective - accumulation is not knowledge.

keyPoints.heading: The 7 topics
keyPoints.text: Discovery; estimation and planning (AI drafts stories, humans review each); backlog; development (measure, don't guess); testing (audit AI tests, focus on integration/E2E); deployment and ALM (deterministic pipeline, AI for release notes); best practices.

keyPoints.heading: Efficiency number
keyPoints.text: (AI costs + people's time + rework) / accepted work. Measure roughly, change one thing at a time.

keyPoints.heading: Microsoft Agent Framework
keyPoints.text: Orchestrator giving each agent the right model; successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen; multi-provider.

resources: Whitepaper: Build at the Speed of AI: The New Power Platform Development Cycle

anthony: How can we define agent efficiency when building out projects?
